criteria.name: Task fulfillment
criteria.description: How completely the response addresses the user's explicit request.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Whether claims and instructions are accurate and internally consistent.

criteria.name: Clarity and relevance
criteria.description: Whether the response is understandable, focused, and appropriately detailed.

score_anchors.0: Not helpful: fails the task or is unusably incorrect.
score_anchors.1: Mostly unhelpful: limited relevant content with major omissions or errors.
score_anchors.2: Partly helpful: addresses the task but has substantial gaps or problems.
score_anchors.3: Helpful: fulfills the task well with only minor shortcomings.
score_anchors.4: Highly helpful: complete, correct, clear, and well matched to the request.
